title: Maze Gen
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: Maze
learningObjectives: Trace the recursive-backtracker algorithm as it marks a cell visited, picks a random unvisited neighbor, removes the wall between them, and pushes the cell onto the stack
Explain why the algorithm pops from the stack when a cell has no unvisited neighbors, producing the backtracking behavior
Identify the grid of cells, each holding four wall flags and a visited flag, as the data structure behind the maze
Predict why every cell ends up reachable and no loops are created, making the finished maze a spanning tree
